from pathlib import Path
import json,sqlite3,sys
root=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
dbp=root/"models/runtime.sqlite"
mr=root/"model_results"/"A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4.json"

if mr.exists():
    try:
        env=json.loads(mr.read_text())
        print("E129=R4_RESULT_EXISTS status="+str(env.get("status"))+" checkpoint="+str(env.get("checkpoint")),flush=True)
    except Exception:
        print("E129=R4_RESULT_EXISTS",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0)

db=sqlite3.connect("file:"+str(dbp)+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
try:
    task=db.execute("select status,attempt,run,thread from tasks where id=?",( "A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4", )).fetchone()
    trs=db.execute("select state,reason,attempt,checkpoint,stamp,retry from transitions where task=? order by seq desc limit 4",( "A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4", )).fetchall()
finally:
    db.close()

print("E129_STATE "+json.dumps({"task":task,"transitions":trs},separators=(",",":"),default=str),flush=True)
if not task:
    raise SystemExit(31)
status,attempt,run,thread=task
if status=="RUNNING":
    print("E129=R4_RUNNING attempt="+str(attempt)+" run="+str(run),flush=True); raise SystemExit(20)
if status=="PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT":
    print("E129=R4_PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT attempt="+str(attempt)+" run="+str(run),flush=True); raise SystemExit(21)
if status=="COMPLETE":
    print("E129=R4_COMPLETE_WITHOUT_RESULT attempt="+str(attempt),flush=True); raise SystemExit(22)
print("E129=R4_STATE_"+str(status)+" attempt="+str(attempt),flush=True); raise SystemExit(29)
